en.title: Correct mipmapped pages on Windows WebGL2 and serve the model gallery
en.body: Multi-level pages use mipmap-capable minification. The example server serves the registered gallery models. The Lanterns check measures the additional light cast when the shrine is reached.

zh.title: 修复 Windows WebGL2 多级纹理与模型画廊入口
zh.body: 多级纹理使用支持 mipmap 的缩小滤波。示例服务器可访问画廊及其已注册模型。灯笼示例按抵达神龛后新增的亮区验收。
